## What this region is

How code builds and uses a json-rules lens (docs/LENS.md §9–13, README § Lens & Multi-Source Data): building and binding a lens, the validate → narrow → execute flow for rules, fetching and projecting rows under a lens, single-path reads, describe-and-validate vs deny at execution, and the migration notes between lens API versions.

## What it exists for

- Safely run a user- or AI-written rule under a lens
- Fetch rows and cut them to what a lens shows
- Fill bind tokens in a lens or rule

## When this is not your domain

These mention this region's words but belong elsewhere; the answer is no, and the region named answers instead.

- Define a lens, save it, load it back → lens-model
- Where do I get a lens for this model → lenses
- Picker options for a lens field → lens-sources
- Which builder hook do I use → rules-builder
